ticket_content: The app keeps crashing on our team in the Midlands, and the login page just won't load for anyone at the factory site.

Our office in Toronto just received a notification that the invoice for March was rejected due to a mismatch in the tax ID — we're not sure how this happened since we've always used the correct one. We need to resolve this immediately before we get penalized by our accounting software.

The CRM integration with HubSpot has stopped syncing data for the past 4 hours. We see empty lead records in HubSpot, and the sync logs show 'connection timeout' errors. We can't update our sales pipeline without it.
I need all my data from the last 18 months deleted, especially the ones from my old office in Leeds that I'm no longer using.
Can you add a feature to allow custom workflows in the project boards? We'd love to set up our own approval steps.
The app keeps crashing when I try to load the dashboard, and my team in Manchester can't access it either. We've tried reloading, but it's been down for over 45 minutes.

I've been locked out of my Northbeam account for over 24 hours now and I'm completely unable to access any of my data or settings. I tried resetting my password via the app and email, but the system keeps saying 'authentication failed' even after multiple attempts. I don't have access to my 2FA device either, and I can't log in from any browser or mobile app. This is affecting every team member on my project, and we're now stuck in a loop of failed logins. I've also noticed that the login screen is showing a message about 'temporary authentication issues' every time I try to enter. I'm concerned this might be a security breach since I didn't authorize any login attempts from a new device. I need immediate help to regain access to my account and verify if there's any unauthorized access. I've already escalated internally, but no one has responded to my messages in the support queue. Our entire workflow is on hold and we're losing client trust due to this. Please confirm if this is a security incident or just a system error. I'm not asking for a new feature — I just need to get back in and know if my data is safe.

I'm based in Manchester and my login keeps timing out every time I try to access the app after 4 PM — it's been happening for two days now, and I can't get into my account to check emails or update team schedules.

We’ve been charged $2,400 for the April billing cycle, but we only have 10 seats and our plan caps at $1,200 per month. Our accountant just reviewed the invoice and found no prior charges for April, and we’ve never seen this amount before. We’re now unable to proceed with client renewals because the invoice is blocking our financial closure. The workspace hasn’t suspended yet, but we’re concerned about being locked into this charge. Can you verify if this is a correct charge and if we can dispute it? We need a resolution within 24 hours as this directly impacts our cash flow and client trust.

I need to get all of my historical data from the Northbeam platform — specifically, every export history, user activity logs, and all project timelines from January 2023 to present. I've tried going to the 'Data & Settings' section and selecting 'Export All Data', but the system keeps redirecting me to a 'maintenance page'. I'm concerned about compliance with our internal GDPR audit, and we need this data for our legal review. Can you please help me extract it or confirm what data is stored in each project and who has accessed it? I also need access to audit logs showing when team members viewed or modified reports in the Project Tracker and the Gantt Board, especially for the 'ClientX' initiative.
I need a feature to export reports directly to Excel, not just CSV. The current export is too limited for our finance team.

We've been experiencing complete failure of the project export functionality for the past three days. Every time we try to export a report, it just hangs and then shows a blank file. This started after the last update, and it's affecting every team member in our organization. We've tried clearing cache, restarting the app, and even manually triggering exports from different browsers, but nothing works. We're now unable to generate financial reports for our clients, and the project managers are stuck without data to present in meetings. Our SLA requires exports to be available within 10 minutes, and we're now 48 hours behind on delivery. This is clearly a systemic issue affecting the entire team, not just one user. I've also noticed that the export logs show a 404 error when hitting the /export endpoint, and the server response times are consistently over 30 seconds. This isn't just a cosmetic glitch—it's blocking our core workflow.

Our monthly invoice from March was charged twice and we haven’t received a refund yet. We’re also seeing a service level agreement warning about overdue billing — this is affecting our ability to show up in client meetings.
The Northbeam app is not loading for any of my team members, and we've been getting 503 errors across all devices and browsers.

I can't access my Northbeam account anymore — I've reset my password and lost my 2FA device, and now I'm locked out completely. I've tried the recovery options, but nothing works. This is affecting my entire team's ability to work on the project timeline.
The export feature has been broken for two days now — every time I try to export data, it just hangs and shows a blank file. We can't close the month without it.
Can you add a way to export reports directly to Excel? We're spending too much time manually copying data.

I'm in the Midlands and need all my data from the last 18 months exported in CSV format. The company is going through a merger and we're doing a full audit of our past operations. Can you please provide a complete export of all activity logs and user data linked to my account?
Our workspace was suspended due to a failed payment on the February invoice, and we can't access the reports until it's resolved.
The Northbeam CRM dashboard is showing a 500 error for all users in the sales team, and we can't see any client data.

I can't access my Northbeam account after multiple password reset attempts. I've tried on both my phone and laptop, and the 2FA device I lost is not helping. My manager said we're losing client meetings because I can't log in, and the service level agreement mentions uptime commitments — can you help me get back in?
I need all my account data exported immediately — including activity logs and user permissions — for compliance review.

The export function in the project dashboard has started returning empty CSV files for the past two days. We've tried restarting the process and clearing the cache, but the issue persists. This is impacting our ability to provide client reports on time.

I've been trying to get the new 'Project Timeline' view to work in the Northbeam app for weeks now. It's been mentioned in several internal emails and demo videos, and I've seen it in the product roadmap for Q3, but it's still not available in the current version. We're using the Northbeam Pro plan and have multiple teams relying on the timeline feature to manage dependencies across projects. Right now, we're using the Gantt view, which is clunky and doesn't sync well with our external calendar tools. The timeline view, especially with drag-and-drop milestones and automatic dependency tracking, would save us hours every week. I've even reached out to the product support team before and was told it's 'in development' — but no timeline has been released. I'm not asking for a workaround, I'm asking for this feature to be built and rolled out. It's not just a small tweak — it's a complete workflow shift. We're already losing productivity because we can't easily visualize project dependencies. If this feature doesn't get prioritized, we're going to have to look at switching to a different project management tool. This has been a major pain point since the start of Q3, and it's becoming critical for our team’s operational efficiency.
I forgot my 2FA device and can't reset it — I need help accessing my account to check the invoice status.

The Northbeam dashboard has been completely blank for all users in our company for over 45 minutes. We checked the login page and it loads, but no data appears in any view, and the service status page shows 'Unreachable'. This is affecting our entire team's ability to review projects and deadlines.

We recently received a charge for $1,200 for the October 2023 subscription, but we only have two users in our workspace and our plan is set to $400 per month. We’ve verified our seat count and confirmed that no additional seats were added. The invoice shows a recurring charge for the entire month, which doesn’t match our billing records. We’re concerned that this could result in a financial discrepancy and want to know if there’s an error in the charge or if we need to dispute it with Northbeam’s billing team. We’ve also checked our payment method — it’s still active and linked correctly. Could you please look into this and either refund the overcharge or explain the breakdown of the billing line item?
Can we add support for Microsoft To-Do integration? We're in the UK and have 150+ users using it daily.

I need all the data from my Northbeam workspace deleted immediately. I've been working with the company for three years, and I'm now exiting the business. I've already requested a data export for audit purposes, but now I need every piece of user, project, and activity data tied to my account — including all team member activity logs, dashboard configurations, and export history — removed completely. I've tried the standard 'delete my account' option, but it only deletes the account, not the underlying data stored in the system. I need a full data purge, and I need it done within the next 24 hours. This is a compliance requirement under my current data protection agreement with our legal team, and I have to provide a certification of data destruction by the end of the day. I've attached a document outlining the data types and retention periods that must be cleared. I’m not asking for a new feature or a login fix — I need every trace of my account and its usage history removed from your servers permanently.

Hi, I'm having a really consistent issue with the export functionality on our project boards. We've been trying to generate monthly reports for stakeholders, and every time we select 'Export to CSV' from the board view, the file comes back blank. This has been happening across multiple boards and for several days now. We've tried different export filters, refreshing the page, and even rebooting our browser, but nothing resolves it. The data appears to be present in the dashboard, and we can view it in the UI, but the export fails completely. This is blocking our ability to provide financial summaries to clients, and we're starting to lose trust in the reporting feature. We're not sure if this is a system-wide issue or specific to our workspace, but we’ve checked the status page and it shows all services are up and running. We’re also seeing that other teams in our organization are reporting similar issues with exports, which makes us think this might be a broader technical problem. Could you please look into this and let us know if there’s a known fix or workaround? We’re also concerned about whether this affects data integrity or could be a security issue, but we haven’t observed any unauthorized access or data leaks. Thanks for your help.

Our entire team can't access the app — the login page just loads a blank screen and times out every time. This has been going on for 4 hours now, and we've tried switching networks, clearing cache, and restarting devices. The service is completely down for all users, and no one can log in or check their dashboards.
Our Stripe subscription for the Northbeam Pro plan expired and the workspace is now suspended, even though we paid in March. Can you restore access immediately?
I'm unable to access my Northbeam account after moving to a new office in Manchester — the login page keeps timing out and I've reset my password three times using the new device.

The export functionality in the reporting module has stopped working for the last 48 hours. We've tried refreshing the page and different export formats, but all generate blank files. This is affecting our monthly client reporting cycle.

I need all of my data deleted from your system — specifically, the project logs, user activity records, and export history from the past two years. I'm doing this because we're consolidating operations and want to ensure no sensitive information remains. Can you confirm when this will be completed and provide a signed GDPR compliance statement?

We're in the Northwest region and have just launched a new project in our regional office in Portland, Oregon. The team there is actively using the Northbeam platform to track client deliveries and timelines. However, we've been trying to set up a custom report that pulls in data from our existing Notion database, which we use across all departments. We’ve searched the documentation and support portal and found no option for integrating with Notion. The current reports only support Google Sheets and Excel, and we can’t find any API endpoint or configuration path for Notion. This is causing delays in our delivery timelines and is impacting our ability to provide real-time visibility to stakeholders in the Pacific Northwest. We’re not seeing any errors in the app, and everything else is working fine — we just need a way to pull data from Notion into Northbeam. We’ve tried to request this through the feature request form before, but it’s been unanswered for over three months. We’re asking now because the new project has tight deadlines and we can’t work without this integration. If this isn’t added, we’ll have to revert to manual processes and lose a lot of efficiency. Could you please prioritize this request? We’re confident this would be a valuable addition for regional teams like ours.
Our March invoice shows a charge for 10 seats instead of 5, and we haven't been charged for April yet.

Our entire team in the Sydney office can't access the Northbeam app right now — the login page just shows a blank screen and no error message, and it's been going on for over 45 minutes. We're trying to get our weekly reports together for the board meeting, and we can't even start. This is affecting every person in our office, including those on the Perth site who are also seeing the same issue.

I'm having trouble accessing my Northbeam account. I reset my password last night using the 'forgot password' option, but when I try to log in, I get a '2FA device not found' error. I don't have access to my original phone or backup device, and I can't seem to recover the authentication method. I'm worried that someone might have used my account without my knowledge, especially since I recently changed my password after seeing an unfamiliar device in the 2FA app logs. I need help resetting my 2FA setup or recovering access to my account immediately.

Our Slack integration has stopped syncing data for the past 4 hours. All messages are missing from the workspace, and we can't see any updates in our project boards. We've tried refreshing the connection, but it hasn't resolved the issue.

I'm running a construction firm and I need a feature that allows me to import project timelines directly from Microsoft Project files. Right now, I have to manually transfer data which takes hours each week.

I need to export all the data from my Northbeam workspace, specifically the project timelines, user activity logs, and financial reports from Q1 2024. I’ve already tried the export tool under 'Reports > Advanced Export' but it’s failing with a 500 error. I also don’t have access to any audit logs, and I’m concerned about compliance with our internal data retention policy. Can you please provide a full export of all data stored in my account, including timestamps and user-level access records? This is critical for our audit team to verify that we didn’t miss any sensitive financial or operational movements.
I lost my 2FA device and can't sign in to my account anymore, all my team members are blocked too.

Our entire team is completely locked out of the Northbeam dashboard. We've tried logging in from multiple devices and browsers, but the app just shows a blank screen with no error message. This started about 45 minutes ago during a routine sync check. All 28 members of the marketing department are unable to access reports, create campaigns, or view customer data. The service appears down globally—our colleagues in the sales team are also reporting the same issue. We're seeing 503 errors in the browser dev tools, and the API is returning 503s on every endpoint. We have no way to communicate with clients or close deals. This affects our entire operational workflow and has already caused a cascade of missed deadlines. We're also concerned because our service-level agreement states that uptime should be 99.9%, and this outage is currently impacting over 100% of our users. We're reaching out to you immediately as this is a full-service outage affecting everyone, not just individual users or isolated features.
I need all my data deleted from the system — specifically, the records from my Melbourne-based team from Q1 2024, as we're moving to a new software provider.

I'm completely stuck with the billing system right now — our last invoice from April 15th shows a charge for 12 seats at $150 per seat, which is way over what we paid. We only have 5 active teams and never went over 5 seats. I checked our plan history and there's no record of a seat increase or upgrade. This charge appears to be duplicated. We need to get a full refund and have a clear explanation of why this charge was applied. The support chatbot just told me to 'review the billing dashboard,' but I can't access it because it's loading with a blank page and spinning for more than 30 seconds. I've already reached out to our finance team who are now investigating, but they can't find any invoice in the system. This has caused major delays in our quarterly reporting and we're worried about future charges. Can someone please verify this charge and issue a refund immediately?

We're in the middle of a major quarterly audit in Brisbane, and our finance team has been unable to generate the quarterly sales reports for the past 3 days. The report templates are showing up in the UI, but when we click 'export to CSV', it just hangs and eventually crashes the browser. We've tried clearing cache, logging out and back in, and even restarted the server on our local machine — nothing works. This is a critical issue because our auditors are due to review the data tomorrow, and we can't deliver the reports. The data we're missing is from the last quarter, and the export fails consistently on all browsers. We've also checked the integration with QuickBooks, and it's not pulling any data either — it's just stuck in 'connecting' mode. This isn't just a cosmetic glitch; we're literally blocked from doing our job. We're desperate and have no workarounds, and I’m not sure if it’s a regional issue since our colleagues in Melbourne are unaffected. Could this be related to the new server migration in the last week? It feels like the export functionality has been broken since then.

We’ve been using Northbeam for over a year and have recently started getting complaints from several team members about the lack of a dashboard for tracking project budgets. Currently, we have to manually track budgets in Excel, which is error-prone and takes up valuable time. We’ve tried to work around it with the existing reports, but they don’t show real-time budget vs. actuals, nor do they allow for variance alerts. Our CFO has emphasized that having a visual budget tracker would significantly improve our financial oversight and reporting. We’ve also noticed that other teams in similar industries use a budget dashboard in their project management tools, and it’s become a key expectation for new clients. We’re not experiencing any outages or errors, and all login and billing functions are working normally. We just need this feature to be available so we can stop losing time and accuracy in financial tracking. This would be a massive improvement and could even become a differentiator for our sales pitch. Could you please consider adding a 'Budget Dashboard' view that shows projected vs. actual spend, with color-coded variances and automated alerts when thresholds are breached? We’re happy to provide user testing or feedback if needed. This request has been growing in frequency and urgency over the past quarter, and it's now a core requirement for our team.

We've been unable to access the Northbeam platform for the past two hours. Every team member in our office is seeing the login page loading with a timeout error, and the app is completely unresponsive. We tried refreshing, restarting our network, and even logging out and back in, but nothing has changed. The customer service portal says it's down, and we're now unable to check in on projects or send updates to clients. This has disrupted our entire workflow, and our team leader is concerned about meeting deadlines. We're also seeing a service level alert from the uptime monitoring tool that shows 99.9% availability dropped below 99% over the last 30 minutes. It's not just a single user issue — it's all of our users. We suspect there might be a backend failure or a misconfiguration in the authentication service that's affecting the entire platform.

We've been receiving duplicate invoices for the March and April billing cycles. It appears that the system charged us twice for the March subscription and again for April, even though we already paid for the March period. The billing records show a split charge, and we're unable to reconcile this with our financial accounting software. We've contacted our accountant to verify, but they're now questioning whether this is a system error or a data sync issue. We're not sure if this is related to a billing discrepancy or a technical issue in the billing engine, but the double charge has already caused us to delay our quarterly financial close. Could you please confirm if this is a known issue or if we need to submit a formal dispute? We're also concerned that this might be a pattern — we have a few other small businesses using the platform who've reported similar issues. Our contract states that billing errors should be resolved within 48 hours, and we're worried about compliance with our agreement if this isn't addressed promptly.

I've been trying to log in to my Northbeam account for the past 4 hours now, and it's still not working. I reset my password three times and tried using both my phone and recovery email, but every time I get redirected to a screen that says 'invalid credentials'. I don't know what's wrong, and I can't access my team's dashboards or any of our active projects. I've also noticed that our team members are all getting the same error when they try to log in — it's not just me. I'm worried this is a widespread outage, and if it's happening across the whole team, then we're completely blocked from doing work. Our SLA says we have to resolve critical access issues within 15 minutes, but we're not even getting a notification that support is aware of this. I'm starting to think someone may have compromised our account or there's a system-wide failure. I need immediate help and a clear update on whether this is a security breach or just a service error.
I need all my data from the last 18 months exported, including team activity logs and project timelines, for compliance review.
The app doesn't have a way to export to Excel directly, it's only CSV. I need this for my team's reporting workflow.
The Northbeam Dashboard is completely blank for all 15 users in our marketing team. We can't see any projects or timelines, and no one can access the board after refresh.
Our Stripe payment failed again for the April subscription, and the workspace is now showing 'payment suspended'.

We've been having this issue with the project timeline syncing for weeks now — it's especially bad during the monthly reviews in the Midlands office. The Gantt charts just won’t update after saving, and the milestones keep shifting by 15 minutes every time. I tried restarting the browser, clearing cache, and even switching to Chrome from Firefox, but nothing helps. The team in Birmingham keeps asking if we can just export the timeline as a CSV so they can check manually, but that’s not working either. It feels like the sync is broken between the app and the server. We’re relying on this for client reporting, and without it, we can’t present accurate timelines to our stakeholders. We’re also noticing that the export button is now grayed out in the report dashboard, even though we’ve been using it for months. This is not a login issue or a billing one — it's clearly a bug with how the data syncs across devices and locations. We're losing trust in the system after so much of this has been going on quietly. I’ve reached out to the help desk multiple times and the last response was just 'this is a known issue' with no ETA. We’re now considering switching to a different tool for our internal planning, which is not a good sign.

I've been locked out of my Northbeam account for over 45 minutes now, and I can't access the dashboard or any of my projects. I tried resetting my password via the email recovery option, but I don’t have access to my recovery email because it’s tied to a work device that was lost last week. I also can't reset my 2FA device since I don’t have access to my phone, and the app keeps showing 'authentication failed' every time I try to sign in. I've already contacted IT support at my company to get a new phone, but until then, I'm completely blocked from doing anything with my workflow. This is impacting my client onboarding and we're missing deadlines. I need immediate assistance to regain access to my account, especially since I'm the only one in my team who has access to the project finance data in the Northbeam Finance module.

The project timeline export has stopped working since last Thursday, and we're unable to generate reports for our clients. We've tried refreshing the page and clearing cache, but nothing helps. This is affecting our ability to close deals on time.
I would like to request a full export of all data stored in my account since January 1st, including user activity logs and project metadata.
Hey, would it be possible to add a feature that lets us track time directly in the project boards, like in Trello? We’re doing a lot of manual tracking right now, and it’s taking up too much time.
Our workspace was suspended after the payment failed for the March subscription, and we can't access any billing information to dispute the charge.

The entire team can't access the Northbeam dashboard right now — it's showing a blank screen and no login option. We've tried clearing cache and switching browsers, but nothing works. All users, including admins, are seeing this.
The dashboard is showing incorrect dates for all our projects, and it's taking over 30 seconds to load on every page. This has been happening since Monday, and our team can't meet client deadlines.

We've been locked out of the Northbeam platform for over 12 hours now. I tried resetting my password three times using the link in the email, but every time it redirects me to a login page that says 'Invalid credentials'. I don't have access to my 2FA device anymore because it was lost during a recent office move. I can't log in from any device or browser — I've tried phone, desktop, and even the mobile app. My manager said we're now missing two key client meetings because I can't access the dashboards. We're worried about compliance since this has been going on for so long, and we don’t know if there’s a data breach or unauthorized access happening. The service level agreement says we should have 99.9% uptime, and this outage is breaking our SLA. We’re also seeing error code 503 on the login endpoint from our monitoring tools, which suggests something is wrong on your side. Can you please confirm if this is a system-wide issue or just my account? If it's a security incident, we need immediate escalation.

I noticed that the dashboard doesn't show the project timelines anymore, even though it was working fine last week. I'm not sure if it's a bug or if there's a change in the data source, but I can still see the tasks in the list. Is there a way to get the timeline view back or is it being deprecated?

I need all of my data deleted immediately. I've been receiving repeated emails about data access audits and I'm now concerned about a possible breach. I didn't authorize any data sharing, and I'm not sure how my data is being accessed or stored. I've already reviewed the privacy policy and the terms, but I can't find any clear information on retention periods or data deletion procedures. I have been getting alerts every 30 minutes about unauthorized access attempts from foreign IP addresses, and I'm worried that my data has been exposed. I need a full data export and deletion of all my account-related information, including user activity logs, project metadata, and any team collaboration data. I'm not asking for a feature or a fix — I'm asking for a complete removal of my account and all associated data, as per GDPR and CCPA rights. This is urgent because I have just received a request from a third-party vendor asking for access to my data, and I cannot allow that to happen without immediate action. I want to confirm that once the deletion is complete, I will receive a confirmation email and a signed attestation of data destruction. I've also seen that there's a 30-day statutory clock for data requests, but I believe that in a breach scenario, that period should be waived or expedited to protect personal data. Can you please confirm the process and timeline for full data deletion?
